description: The Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) submits to Texas A&M University (TAMU) a financial guarantee letter for each student awarded a scholarship by the Government of Saudi Arabia to attend TAMU. The letter establishes the course of study for the student, the terms of the scholarship, and costs SACM will pay.  SACM pays directly to TAMU tuition and required academic fees as long as the student is enrolled on a full-time basis, as defined in the letter, in the academic program specified in the letter. SACM provides full and comprehensive medical coverage for their scholarship students and requires TAMU to waive any student insurance charges. TAMU is required to provide the SACM proof of the student’s registration at the beginning of each semester and an official transcript at the completion of a semester.  TAMU is required to notify SACM in writing if the student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Any refunds for dropped courses is required to return to SACM.  Based student actions and/or inactions enumerated in the guarantee letter, SACM may void the scholarship and will provide adequate notice to TAMU.

The letter establishes the course of study for the students, the terms of the scholarship, and costs SACM will pay.  SACM pays directly to the university tuition and required academic fees as long as the students are enrolled on a full-time basis, as defined in the letter, in the academic program specified in the letter. SACM provides full and comprehensive medical coverage for their scholarship students and requires Texas A&M to waive any student insurance charges. Texas A&M is required to provide SACM proof of each sponsored student’s registration at the beginning of each semester and an official transcript at the completion of a semester.  Texas A&M is required to notify SACM in writing if any of the students drop courses or withdraw during a semester.  Any refunds for dropped courses are required to return to SACM.  Based on each student’s actions and/or inactions enumerated in the guarantee letter, SACM may void the scholarship and will provide adequate notice to Texas A&M prior to doing so.

The Aramco Americas Co. (Aramco) submits to Texas A&M University a statement of financial support letter for each student they sponsor to attend the university. The letter establishes the course of study for the students, and costs Aramco will pay towards the stated degree until completion of the program.  Aramco pays directly to the university tuition, required academic fees, medical costs, and living expenses for each of the students. Texas A&M must submit an invoice to Aramco for each of the student.  Any refunds or credits must be returned directly to Aramco.

principal: Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia
description: The Cultural Mission pays the university tuition, required academic fees, and living expenses for selected Saudi students to attend Texas A&M in a specified full-time course of study as established by the Mission. principal: Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia Cultural Mission to the USA
description: The financial guarantee provides tuition funding to the sponsored student as long as the student is enrolled on a full-time basis in an academic or English as a Second Language program for the degree and major stated in the financial guarantee. The scholarship covers the full tuition and other required academic fees. The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students. ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location. Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM. Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM. SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester. Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval. SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition. The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad programs

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

The student should register for the standard course load as a full-time international student with a minimum of 12 credits for a semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and a minimum of 9 credits for a semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students.  ESL students must attend at least 20 hours a week of teacher directed classroom instruction and all classes should be taken on location.  Tuition for dropped courses should be refunded directly to the Cultural Mission of the Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia (SACM) if already paid by SACM or invoiced directly to the student if not yet paid by SACM.  Refund checks should be made payable only to SACM.  SACM should be notified in writing when a student drops or withdraws during a semester.  Online/hybrid courses are not allowed and will not be covered by the financial guarantee without SACM’s written pre-approval.  SACM will issue a separate financial guarantee for online/hybrid tuition.  The financial guarantee will not pay for fees related to study abroad

principal: Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia, Cultural Mission to the U.S.A
description: The Saudi Arabian Cultural Mission (SACM) to the United States is one of the specialized agencies created by the Saudi government in 1951 to administer programs and policies to meet the educational and cultural needs of Saudis studying in the United States. It also functions as an intermediary between U.S. educational institutions and their counterparts in the Kingdom in terms of issues pertaining to culture, education and science. The scholarship provides tuition funding to the sponsored student, as long as the student is enrolled on a fulltime basis in an academic (undergraduate or graduate) or English as a Second Language programs.

principal: The Saudi Arabian Cultural Mission (SACM) to the United States
description:
Contract amounts vary by student. Start and End dates also vary by student and are typically for one semester. The scholarship covers the full tuition and other relevant required academic fees. The student is required to register for the standard course load as a full-time international student, with a minimum of
12 credits for the semester for undergraduate students and 9 credits for the semester. ESL students are required to attend no fewer than 20 hours per week of teacher directed classroom instruction. This does not include field trips, self study, etc. All classes should be taken on location. SACM provides a directly deposited monthly stipend to students and their families to cover the cost of living, including
clothing, books, foods and travel. Financial guarantees are valid and binding from the effective date until the void date listed on the letter, or upon graduation, whichever comes first.

academic (undergraduate or graduate) or English as a Second Language programs.
2. The scholarship covers the full tuition and other relevant required academic fees.
3. SACM provides a directly deposited monthly stipend to students and their families to cover the cost of living, including
clothing, books, foods and travel.
4. The scholarship provides full and comprehensive health insurance (medical and dental) with no deductable to
students and their families. Consequently, SACM expects a waiver for any imposed additional school-sponsored
health insurance charges.
5. The student is required to register for the standard course load as a full-time international student, with a minimum of
12 credits for the semester system or 15 credits for the quarter system for undergraduate students and 9 credits for
the semester system or 12 credits for the quarter system for graduate students. ESL students are required to attend
no fewer than 20 hours per week of teach
